raw_response:
Well, it's the start of the season, and at my age I mostly do what I've always done. Let me think through each field.

---

We have 12 mu in total. I'll keep 8 mu in cotton and 4 mu in the wheat-maize rotation, same as the past few years. Cotton is our cash crop — that's what pays for the grandchildren's school money when they visit, and our medicine. The wheat and maize feed us and the chickens, with a bit left to sell if prices are decent. My husband and I do most of the work ourselves. The children are in Handan city and only come back for Spring Festival.

**Cotton (8 mu).** I'll plant around April 20, once the soil is warm enough. I buy improved seed from the same shop on the county road — about 50 yuan per mu, same brand as last year. Before planting, my husband deep-plows with the ox plow he borrows from my brother-in-law. I broadcast about 30 kg of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer per mu at planting, and when the cotton starts flowering I topdress around 15 kg of urea. That's maybe 11 kg of nitrogen per mu. The extension man told us we could use more, but fertilizer is expensive now and cotton prices have been flat. I'd rather save the money.

For pests, I walk the field once or twice a week and spray what I see — aphids early, then bollworm in July-August. Usually three sprays. I irrigate twice from the well — once after planting if May is dry, and once at flowering. Pumping costs add up. Picking starts in September; my husband and I do the first picking ourselves, then I'll hire a neighbor lady for about 6 days for the second and third picks. My back can't take three rounds of picking anymore. I expect maybe 250 kg of lint per mu if the weather is normal — that's about what we got last year.

**Wheat (4 mu).** The wheat is already growing — I planted it back on October 10th last fall. I put down DAP and a bit of urea at planting, maybe 25 kg of DAP per mu. At greening in early March I did the first topdress, about 10 kg of urea per mu, and I'll do a smaller one at jointing if it looks pale. Total nitrogen maybe 13 kg per mu. I'll irrigate three times — I've already done the greening one; still need jointing and heading. I sprayed herbicide in March. If I see rust in May I'll spray fungicide too. Harvest around June 10th. Stand looks decent this year, so I'm hoping for 400 kg per mu.

**Maize (4 mu).** Right after wheat harvest, within a week, I direct-sow hybrid maize into the wheat stubble. No tilling — no time for it. Seed is about 40 yuan per mu from the same shop. I put down 25 kg of compound fertilizer at planting and then about 12 kg of urea at big trumpet stage in late July. One irrigation in July if it's dry. Herbicide after emergence, and one insecticide spray for borers if I see damage. Harvest end of September — I need to finish maize before cotton picking gets heavy, which is always tight. I expect around 430 kg per mu.

Budget-wise, I've set aside about 5,000 yuan for this season's inputs. Most of it goes to cotton because of the picker's wages. Wheat and maize together are cheaper. I keep a little in reserve — you never know when a pump breaks or somebody gets sick.
